method.measured: 2026-10-15 on the Windows 11 test VM, the real Spitfire Symphony Orchestra in Kontakt Player 8.13.1 (VST 3), offline, by the VM's test host kthost (MD5 ea7e692e), one process per patch, setups as sso_gap_cc1_curves.json
method.events: velocity = CC1 at 16 .. 127 (126 on the metal patches: maxVelocity), 4 takes (the timpani 2, at 32 / 64 / 80 / 112), each held 7 s; the harp (Normale, CC32 1) every 6 semitones 24 .. 96, 1.5 s apart; the timpani every key 46 .. 62, 1.5 s apart; the percussion hits on key 48 (Bass Drum Hit, Piatti Hit, Snare 1 Hit, Tam Tam Hit, Triangle 1 Open Hit 1), 13 s apart (the metals ring)
method.measures: loudDb: the loudest 50 ms of the note and 0.5 s more (the dynamics check's); cumE: both channels' mean square through the fast time weighting (125 ms) summed from 0.25 s before the note-on to cumT s after it, dB re 1 FS^2 s (as tu_decaying.json's energy); f0Hz (the timpani): the strongest spectral peak 30 .. 400 Hz in 0.3 .. 1.5 s: key 46 sounds 58.5 Hz (A#1), key 50 72.8 Hz (D2): the keys sound an octave under their MIDI number
